component.name: Modal
component.description: Dialog overlay with header, content, footer, and variant-based styling (default, success, error, warning, info, loading).

parts.label: dialog header
parts.description: Title, optional icon, and close button.

parts.label: dialog footer
parts.description: Action buttons or custom footer content.

behavior.map: Modal dialog with overlay. Six variants: default, success, error, warning, info, loading. Semantic variants (error, warning) use alertdialog role. Info/success use dialog role. No aria-live on dialog elements (role already implies announcement, adding aria-live causes double screen reader announcements). Loading variant shows spinner. Default footer: OK button (unless custom footer or loading variant). Closes on Escape or overlay click (if onClose provided). Close button optional (showCloseIcon prop).
behavior.rendering: Renders if isOpen=true. Header renders if title provided. Icon renders if variant has semantic icon or icon prop provided. Footer renders unless variant=loading and no custom footer. Spinner renders if variant=loading.

content: Title optional but recommended for accessibility.
nesting: Should not nest modals inside modals.

roles.dialog: dialog (default, success, info, loading) | alertdialog (error, warning)

aria.label: aria-label='Dialog' (if no title).
aria.live: No aria-live on dialog elements. The role (dialog/alertdialog) already implies announcement behavior. Adding aria-live causes double screen reader announcements.

accessibility.keyboard: Escape closes dialog. Focus trapped within dialog (implicit).
accessibility.focus: Focus should move to dialog on open (not implemented).
accessibility.contrast: Title and content meet WCAG AA.

responsiveness.rules: Modal scales to fit viewport on small screens.

usageNotes: Variants: default, success, error, warning, info, loading.
Semantic variants auto-inject icons (can override with icon prop).
Error/warning use alertdialog role (no aria-live needed, role implies announcement).
Default footer: OK button (unless loading variant or custom footer).
Close on Escape or overlay click (if onClose provided).
useId generates unique title ID for aria-labelledby.
Close button icon customizable (closeIconName prop, default: 'x').
Close button label customizable (closeButtonLabel prop, default: 'Close dialog').
Modal should trap focus (not fully implemented).
IMPORTANT: Do not add aria-live to dialog/alertdialog elements - it causes double screen reader announcements.
